steps.clue: Repair the Harmonic Oculus and defend it to unlock Pack-a-Punch.
Trap the roaming enemy with three contraptions and recover the LGM-1.
Eavesdrop on O.S.C.A.R., enter the planet code, and recover the Cryo Chamber Key.
Extract Thurston’s brain, defend the Perfusion Machine, and install it in Machina Astralis.
Enter Mars’s coordinates, solve Thurston’s Reading List, and recover Neptune.
Install Neptune and align the three planets with their indicated directions.
Defend the portal from O.S.C.A.R.’s drones and travel to Mars.
Install the Perfusion Machine, shoot the distant pylons in order, and capture the Ascendant Eye.
Place the Ascendant Eye and activate the five pillars with the Wonder Weapon.
Interact with the Mars pillars in the Harmonic Oculus sequence, then defeat Caltheris.
